title: Putting Right a Crossover Line the Supplement Settled for a Day It Did Not Cover
content:
A policy under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies settles nothing for a day it was not in force, so a crossover line the supplement has paid whose date of service falls on such a day is put right: what the supplement paid is taken back from whoever received it, and the liability the line records is restated to what the policyholder genuinely owes for that day.

The restatement is booked against the policy and stands on the claim record beside the line it corrects, with a status showing the line has been adjusted. Booking it takes back from whoever received it what the supplement paid on that line, records with it the amount of the recorded liability that is no longer the policyholder's, and lowers the year's deductible accumulator by that amount.

## Booking the restatement

The restatement is booked with `book_precoverage_restatement_aba9484f`, which is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it and then calls it. One call restates one named line.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form it takes |
|---|---|---|
| `medigap_policy_id` | The reference number of the Medicare Supplement policy the restated line sits on, read from the policyholder's policy record | An identifier |
| `customer_id` | The member reference number of the policyholder whose line is being restated, read from their member profile | An identifier |
| `source_claim_id` | The reference number of the single processed crossover line this restatement applies to, read from the claims that crossed over to that policy | An identifier |
| `medicare_claim_number` | The number Medicare gave the original claim, carried over from the line being restated exactly as it stands there | A thirteen-character Medicare claim control number |
| `date_of_service` | The date the service was rendered, carried over from the line being restated | Written as YYYY-MM-DD |
| `reversed_payment_amount` | The money the supplement paid on the line being restated and is now taking back, in USD | Recorded to 2 decimal places and never negative; it is booked against the policy as a negative payment |
| `liability_restated` | The part of the liability the line records that is no longer the policyholder's once the line is restated, in USD | Recorded to 2 decimal places and never negative |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence in plain text naming the reference number of the new claim record, the line it restates, the payment taken back and the liability restated. Receiving that sentence is what says the restatement stands on the claim record; no other value is returned.
